effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card―both with the [Xros Heart] trait―among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Shoutmon] in its name, it gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.).
